findings.title: Reentrancy Balance
findings.description:
Reentrancy in AlphaProVault.withdraw(uint256,uint256,uint256,address) (contracts/AlphaProVault.sol#293-341):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- (baseAmount0,baseAmount1) = _burnLiquidityShare(baseLower,baseUpper,shares,totalSupply) (contracts/AlphaProVault.sol#317-322)
		- (burned0,burned1) = pool.burn(tickLower,tickUpper,liquidity) (contracts/AlphaProVault.sol#523)
		- (collect0,collect1) = pool.collect(address(this),tickLower,tickUpper,type()(uint128).max,type()(uint128).max) (contracts/AlphaProVault.sol#527-533)
	Balance read before the call:
	- amount0 = getBalance0().mul(shares).div(totalSupply) (contracts/AlphaProVault.sol#307)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- require(bool,string)(amount0 >= amount0Min,amount0Min) (contracts/AlphaProVault.sol#333)
		- stale variable `amount0`
